title: Trait Family
intro: Some traits come from parents. Others change because of where and how a living thing lives. Which is which?
note: This is a model. A real plant grown in the sun and one in the shade give you evidence of your own.
summary: Traits like eye color and leaf shape are inherited from parents. Other traits, such as a thin, pale stem grown in the dark or shade, or a small plant grown without enough water, are influenced by the environment.

stages.prompt: Is this trait inherited from parents, or did the environment or experience change it?

cards.label: A child's eye color
cards.why: Eye color is passed from parents to their children.
cards.hint: was the child born with it, from the parents?

cards.label: The basic shape of an oak leaf
cards.why: An acorn grows into an oak with oak leaves, because the leaf shape is passed from the parent tree.
cards.hint: will an acorn grow into a tree with oak leaves or maple leaves?

cards.label: A violet's flower color
cards.why: Flower color is passed from parent plants to their seeds.
cards.hint: does the plant get it from its parent plants?

cards.label: A kitten's striped fur
cards.why: Fur pattern is inherited from the kitten's parents.
cards.hint: was the kitten born with it?

cards.label: A bean grown in the dark is pale and thin
cards.why: A bean plant grown without light is pale and weak. The same kind of bean in the sun is green and sturdy.
cards.hint: what was different about where the bean grew?

cards.label: Shade bean: tall, thin, pale
cards.why: The shade plant stretched to 22 cm, but its stem was thin, pale and its leaves small. Same seeds, same water: the shade changed how it grew.
cards.hint: the seeds and water were the same. What was different?

cards.label: Sun bean: thick green stem
cards.why: The sun plant had a thick green stem and wide leaves. The same kind of bean looked different in the shade, so the environment changed how it grew.
cards.hint: the same kind of bean looks different in shade. What changed?

cards.label: A plant that stays small without enough water
cards.why: A plant that does not get enough water stays small, even if its parents grow tall. The environment influenced how it grew.
cards.hint: if its parents grow tall, what else could keep this plant small?

cards.label: A puppy's floppy ears
cards.why: Ear shape is passed from the puppy's parents.
cards.hint: was the puppy born with it, like its parents?

cards.label: A dog that has learned to sit
cards.why: The dog learned to sit from practice and training. Learning is experience, not something passed from parents.
cards.hint: was the dog born knowing it, or did it learn it?

cards.label: A scar on a knee
cards.why: A scar comes from an injury during life. It is not passed from parents to children.
cards.hint: did the child get it from the parents, or from something that happened?
